criteria.requirement: Implement statemachine.snapshots.snapshot(machine), freeze(value) and frozen StateSnapshot(states,values,allowed_events). Capture actual StateChart.configuration order, state IDs and JSON-compatible values, stable-deduplicate actual allowed_events. Deep-freeze standard containers, reject cycles/nonfinite/unsupported values. Do not run enabled_events/guards, callbacks, sends or implicit async initial activation; an unactivated configuration stays as actually observed. Clarify structural allowed events do not promise guards pass. Preserve original model/configuration/listeners.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
